title: 过去进行时·基本用法

examples.en: I was doing my homework at eight last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚八点我正在做作业。

examples.en: They were watching TV when I came in.
examples.zh: 我进来的时候他们正在看电视。

guess.question: 两句话说的都是过去的事，为什么这里不用过去式，而用 was/were + doing？

options.text: 因为说的是过去某个时刻“正在”进行的动作
options.feedback: 对！“昨晚八点”“我进来的那一刻”都是正在进行的时间点。

options.text: 因为这些事情早就做完了
options.feedback: 不对——做完了要用一般过去时，这里强调的是“正在进行中”。

options.text: 因为句子里有两个动作
options.feedback: 不对——动作多少不是判据，关键是有没有“正在”这个意思。

rule.rule: 过去某一时刻或某段时间正在进行的动作
rule.formula: was / were + 动词-ing（I / he / she / it 用 was，we / you / they 用 were）

anchors.en: I was doing my homework at eight last night.
anchors.zh: 昨晚八点我正在做作业。
anchors.note: at eight last night 点明那一刻

anchors.en: They were watching TV when I came in.
anchors.zh: 我进来的时候他们正在看电视。

trap.wrong: He was watch TV at that time.
trap.right: He was watching TV at that time.
trap.why: be 动词后面必须接动词的 -ing 形式，不能接原形。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住：过去进行时 = 过去的某个瞬间“正在做”，看到 at eight last night、at that time 就往它身上想。

check.stem: I ____ (read) a book at nine last night.

options.distractor: at nine last night 强调那一刻正在进行

check.explanation: 昨晚九点那一刻正在看书，用 was reading。

check.stem: They ____ (play) football at four yesterday afternoon.

options.distractor: played 只说明“踢了”，不强调四点那一刻正在进行

check.explanation: 昨天下午四点那一刻正在踢球，用 were playing。

options.text: He was watching TV at that time.
He was watch TV at that time.
options.distractor: be 动词后要接 -ing 形式

options.text: He watching TV at that time.
He were watching TV at that time.

check.explanation: he 用 was，动词用 -ing：He was watching TV at that time。
